construction financing right you bring that land as Equity into the deal right the benefit of
this is you own the land with cash and you don't have to pay interest on that money while you
are putting together architectural drawings and submitting for permitting okay that's going to
save you a lot of money also while you're submitting for permitting if the market crashes or
something crazy happens you're not stuck with the land loan you own the land with cash that's
nice the cons to this strategy is that you need cash up front to purchase the land option two is
give yourself a longer time to get land financed so that you bring in one loan to close in a
land and that will also fund your construction now you can also do these in two separate loans
you can get a loan on the land pay that loan while you're putting together architectural plans
and submitting for permitting and then the construction loan will take out the land loan and

structure it so the pro to this is you need less cash up front because you're going to be able
